system: ALCHEMY MINIGAME (reaction-chain brewing) — Game-1-modular/Crafting-subdisciplines/alchemy.py + core/difficulty_calculator.py + core/reward_calculator.py + engine wiring in core/game_engine.py
summary: Sequential reaction-chain timing minigame. Each recipe input becomes a bubbling reaction that advances through 5 stages on fixed per-type timers; the player presses CHAIN (C) to lock the current reaction's quality — an oscillating sine-based value with a per-ingredient hidden max derived from vowel counts of material IDs — and start the next ingredient, or STABILIZE (S) to lock and finish. Final progress (sum of locked qualities, 0-1) maps through a shared reward calculator (chain-ratio 0.6 + timing 0.4 − 0.15/explosion + 0.10 first-try) into potency/duration multipliers and a quality tier; progress < 0.25 fails with difficulty-scaled material loss (30-90%). Difficulty points = material tier points × diversity × 1.2^(avgTier−1) × (1 + vowel-volatility×0.3), interpolated over 1-80 points into time limit and tier label; the tier label picks the ingredient behavior types (stable/moderate/volatile/legendary).
player_facing: Craft at an alchemy station starts brewing: ingredients are processed one at a time in recipe-input order; a reaction 'bubble' grows through 5 visual stages — initiation, building (with fake glow-spike 'false peaks'), SWEET SPOT (steady intense glow, glow=0.9, saturated color), degrading (flicker/fade), critical (dark, over-expanded) (alchemy.py:193-225)

Inputs: keyboard C = chain (lock quality, start next ingredient), S = stabilize (lock and end brew) (game_engine.py:729-733); equivalent on-screen buttons 'CHAIN [C]' and 'STABILIZE' are clickable (game_engine.py:2482-2500, 9967-9982)
Countdown timer shown; when it hits 0 the brew auto-stabilizes with whatever progress is banked (alchemy.py:548-551)

Letting a reaction run past stage 5 explodes THAT ingredient: message '+10% progress', explosion counter increments, and the game auto-advances to the next ingredient (or auto-stabilizes if none left) (alchemy.py:558-571)
Double-ESC within 1500 ms abandons the craft (materials lost); single ESC shows a warning notification (game_engine.py:709-726)

HUD state exposed per frame: current ingredient name, its volatility color value (0-1), its max-quality share, index/total ingredients, locked reactions list, total progress, time left/limit (alchemy.py:751-779); per-reaction visuals: size, glow, color_shift, oscillation_count, max_quality, secret_value (alchemy.py:302-316)
Result banner: 'Quality: earned/100 points | Duration: N%, Effect: N%' plus quality tier name; failures report loss percentage and explosion count (alchemy.py:736-749, 1005-1012)
Success yields the recipe output with stats potency/duration/quality, rarity inherited from (uniform) input rarity, and a 'potion' vs 'transmutation' label from recipe tags (alchemy.py:1063-1075)
mechanics: Core loop: start() resets state, time_left=time_limit, spawns reaction for input[0] (alchemy.py:501-512); update(dt) ticks timer down then advances current reaction (alchemy.py:537-556); chain() locks quality into total_progress and spawns next input, auto-stabilizing after the last one (alchemy.py:573-601); stabilize() locks the current unlocked reaction then calls end(explosion=False) (alchemy.py:603-621)
Reaction stage progression: progress += dt / current_stage_duration; at progress>=1.0 reset to 0 and stage+=1; stage>5 → stage=6 (explosion), locked_quality=0.0 (alchemy.py:165-188)

Per-type stage timing tables (seconds, stages 1-5): stable [1.0,2.5,2.0,2.0,1.5] sweet 2.0s no false peaks; moderate [0.8,2.0,1.5,1.5,1.2] sweet 1.5s peaks at stage-2 progress [0.4,0.7]; volatile [0.5,1.5,1.0,1.0,0.8] sweet 1.0s peaks [0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9]; legendary [0.4,1.0,0.5,0.7,0.5] sweet 0.5s peaks [0.2,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.8] (alchemy.py:135-154)

Speed bonus (= engine total_time_bonus) multiplies every stage duration and the sweet-spot duration by (1.0 + bonus) — it slows the reaction; it does NOT extend the brew time limit (alchemy.py:156-161, 352-357)
Secret value per ingredient: over alphabetic chars of its ID, vowel_ratio = vowels/letters; secret = clamp((ratio − 0.2) × 2.0, 0, 1); 0.5 if no letters (alchemy.py:78-105)
Oscillation count from secret value: <0.25 → 1 cycle; <0.65 → 2; else 3 (alchemy.py:107-127)

Quality-if-locked-now (get_quality): total_progress=(stage−1+progress)/5; cycle_progress=total_progress×osc; cycle_value=sin(fraction×π); amplitude=1.0 if osc==1 else 0.6+0.4×min(current_cycle,osc−1)/(osc−1); final_peak_progress=(osc−0.5)/osc; base_fraction=min(0.45, 0.15+(total_progress/final_peak_progress)×0.30); quality_fraction=base_fraction+cycle_value×amplitude×0.55; result=clamp(quality_fraction×max_quality, 0, max_quality); stage>=6 returns 0 (alchemy.py:227-290)
Per-ingredient dynamic max quality: maxQ_i = vowelCount(itemId_i) / totalVowels across all inputs (they sum to 1.0); equal 1/N split if total vowels is 0 (alchemy.py:372-410)
Explosion during update: explosions+=1; total_progress += 0.10 flat; exploded reaction still appended to locked_reactions; advance to next ingredient or auto-stabilize (alchemy.py:558-571)

End (non-explosion): if total_progress < 0.25 → failure, materials_lost = calculate_failure_penalty(points), duration/effect mult 0; else success with quality tier + duration/potency multipliers from calculate_alchemy_rewards (alchemy.py:657-685)
Performance dict fed to rewards: chains_completed=len(locked_reactions), total_chains=len(inputs), avg_timing_score=int(progress×100), explosions, attempt (alchemy.py:664-670)

Reward formula: base_perf = clamp(chain_ratio×0.6 + timing/100×0.4 − explosions×0.15, 0, 1); +0.10 if attempt==1 (capped 1.0); max_mult = 1.0 + norm(points over 1-80)×1.5; potency_mult = clamp(1+(perf−0.5)×(max_mult−1), 0.25, 2.0); duration_mult = clamp(1+(perf−0.5)×(max_mult−1)×0.6, 0.25, 2.0); quality tier from perf thresholds (reward_calculator.py:294-368, 81-104)
Quality tiers: [0,0.25) Normal, [0.25,0.50) Fine, [0.50,0.75) Superior, [0.75,0.90) Masterwork, [0.90,1.01) Legendary (reward_calculator.py:34-40)
Buff quality bonus multiplies BOTH duration_mult and effect_mult by (1+bonus) after tiering (alchemy.py:727-729); earned_points=int(progress×100), max_points=100 (alchemy.py:731-734)

Difficulty: points = Σ(tier×qty) × (1+(unique−1)×0.1) × 1.2^(avgTier−1) × (1 + volatility×0.3) (difficulty_calculator.py:414-428); volatility = clamp((vowel_ratio_of_all_input_ids − 0.3)×2.5, 0, 1) (difficulty_calculator.py:450-480); avgTier is quantity-weighted (difficulty_calculator.py:207-250)

Points interpolate linearly over [1, 80] into ALCHEMY_PARAMS: time_limit 60→20 (int-rounded), reaction_count 2→6 (rounded, min 2), sweet_spot_duration 2.0→0.4, stage_duration 2.5→0.8, false_peaks 0→5 (rounded), volatility 0→1; difficulty_tier label added (difficulty_calculator.py:253-283, 379-397, 430-447)

Difficulty tier → ingredient-type list (first 3 ingredients): common [stable,stable,moderate]; uncommon [stable,moderate,moderate]; rare [moderate,moderate,volatile]; epic [moderate,volatile,volatile]; legendary [volatile,volatile,legendary]; ingredients beyond index 2 typed by recipe volatility: >0.7 legendary, >0.4 volatile, >0.2 moderate, else stable (alchemy.py:446-479)

Failure material loss fraction = 0.30 + norm(points over 1-80)×0.60 (range 0.30-0.90) (reward_calculator.py:497-519, 43-46); per-material loss = int(quantity × fraction), inventory floored at 0, losses of 0 skipped (alchemy.py:996-1003)
Crafter pre-checks: can_craft requires each input quantity in inventory AND all input materials share one rarity (rarity uniformity) (alchemy.py:869-893)

craft_instant (skip minigame): deducts materials inline, returns base output with duration_mult=effect_mult=1.0, rarity from inputs, is_consumable/effect_type from recipe metadata tags (alchemy.py:895-947)

craft_with_minigame success: does NOT deduct materials (engine's RecipeDatabase.consume_materials owns that); base_stats = {potency:int(100×effect_mult), duration:int(100×duration_mult), quality:earned_points}; then rarity modifiers applied by item category; 'duration' stat deleted for effect_type 'heal' or 'damage' (alchemy.py:1014-1057)

Engine wiring: buff_time_bonus = max('quicken' buffs for alchemy); buff_quality_bonus = max('empower','elevate'); title bonuses alchemyTime + alchemyQuality added; totals passed to create_minigame(recipe_id, total_time_bonus, total_quality_bonus) (game_engine.py:4220-4261, 4280)
Explosion end-path (end(explosion=True)): materials_lost = min(0.9, penalty+0.1), quality 'Complete Failure', progress 0 (alchemy.py:635-655) — currently unreachable, see hazards
data: recipes.JSON/recipes-alchemy-1.json + recipes.JSON/recipes-tag-tests.JSON — top-level 'recipes' list filtered to stationType=='alchemy' (alchemy.py:800-837); consumed fields: recipeId ('alchemy_minor_health_potion'), outputId ('minor_health_potion'), outputQty (3), stationTier (1, legacy fallback only), inputs [{materialId:'slime_gel', quantity:2}, ...] ('itemId' also accepted), metadata.tags (['potion','healing','starter']) for is_consumable/effect_type
placements.JSON/placements-alchemy-1.JSON — 'placements' list keyed by recipeId; served via get_placement, not used by minigame logic itself (alchemy.py:840-867)
MaterialDatabase (items.JSON/items-materials-1.JSON) — per-material 'tier' (1-4) for points and weighted average tier; missing material defaults tier 1 (difficulty_calculator.py:150-173, 234-250)

rarity_utils.rarity_system — per-material rarity lookups for uniformity check (must all match; debug mode bypasses to 'common'), get_item_category(outputId, metadata) → weapon/armor/tool/consumable/device, apply_rarity_modifiers(base_stats, category, rarity); 'common' rarity applies no modifiers (rarity_utils.py:82-116, 129-147, 175-193; alchemy.py:886-891, 1042-1043)

core.crafting_tag_processor.AlchemyTagProcessor — is_consumable(tags) and get_effect_type(tags) from recipe metadata.tags; effect_type in {'heal','damage'} strips duration stat (alchemy.py:926-931, 1046-1057)

Material IDs themselves are data: vowel counts of ID strings drive secret_value, oscillation pattern, per-ingredient max quality, and recipe volatility — renaming a material changes gameplay (alchemy.py:78-105, 372-410; difficulty_calculator.py:462-479)
constants: Stage duration tables + sweet-spot durations + false-peak positions per ingredient type (alchemy.py:135-154)
Speed-bonus scaling: duration × (1.0 + speed_bonus) on all stages + sweet spot (alchemy.py:156-161)
Quality curve: total_progress divisor 5.0; amplitude 0.6 + 0.4×idx/(n−1) (1.0 for n=1); final_peak=(n−0.5)/n; base 0.15→0.45 cap; oscillation share ×0.55 (alchemy.py:251-288)
Explosion: flat +0.10 total_progress per exploded ingredient (alchemy.py:562); stage>5 → stage 6, quality 0 (alchemy.py:186-188)
Failure threshold: total_progress < 0.25 (alchemy.py:674); explosion-end extra loss +0.1 capped 0.9, ImportError fallback 0.75 (alchemy.py:640-642)
earned_points = int(progress×100); max_points = 100 (alchemy.py:733-734); base_stats potency=int(100×effect_mult), duration=int(100×duration_mult) (alchemy.py:1031-1035)

TIER_POINTS {1:1,2:2,3:3,4:4} (difficulty_calculator.py:35-40); diversity 1.0+(unique−1)×0.1 (difficulty_calculator.py:204); tier_modifier 1.2^(avg_tier−1) (difficulty_calculator.py:422); volatility clamp((ratio−0.3)×2.5,0,1) (difficulty_calculator.py:479); total ×(1+volatility×0.3) (difficulty_calculator.py:428)

ALCHEMY_PARAMS: time_limit (60,20), reaction_count (2,6), sweet_spot_duration (2.0,0.4), stage_duration (2.5,0.8), false_peaks (0,5), volatility (0.0,1.0) (difficulty_calculator.py:379-397); interpolation range min_points=1.0, max_points=80.0 (difficulty_calculator.py:56-59)
DIFFICULTY_THRESHOLDS: common 0-4, uncommon 5-10, rare 11-20, epic 21-40, legendary 41-150 and above (difficulty_calculator.py:47-53, 764-772)

Reward weights: chain 0.6 + timing 0.4; explosion penalty 0.15 each; first-try +0.10 (FIRST_TRY_BONUS, alchemy per-discipline also 0.10); REWARD_MULTIPLIER 1.0→2.5 (i.e. 1+norm×1.5); potency clamp [0.25,2.0]; duration factor ×0.6 same clamp (reward_calculator.py:28-31, 52-62, 328-358)

Legacy ImportError fallbacks (preserve tables): points=tier×15; time limits T1-T4 = 60/45/30/20s with fixed type lists (alchemy.py:481-499); quality bands at progress 0.25/0.50/0.75/0.90/0.99 with duration/effect mult pairs (0.5,0.5)/(0.75,0.75)/(1.0,1.0)/(1.2,1.1)/(1.5,1.25) (alchemy.py:687-724)
Reaction default max_quality fallback 0.30; default type 'moderate' for overflow ingredients (alchemy.py:525-531, 46)
hazards: Interpolated difficulty params sweet_spot_duration / stage_duration / false_peaks / reaction_count are stored on the minigame (alchemy.py:428-431) but NEVER passed into AlchemyReaction — reaction pacing comes only from the hardcoded per-type tables (alchemy.py:135-154, 535). Difficulty actually influences only time_limit, the tier label (→ ingredient types), and points (→ rewards/penalty). Port this as-is; wiring the params in would change balance.

end(explosion=True) is dead code: individual explosions add +0.10 and continue; end() is only ever called via stabilize() with explosion=False, so the 'brew exploded' total-failure result and its min(0.9, penalty+0.1) loss can never occur (alchemy.py:558-571, 603-621, 635-655)
attempt is initialized to 1 and never incremented, so the +0.10 first-try bonus applies to every brew (alchemy.py:347, 669; reward_calculator.py:343-345)

avg_timing_score sent to rewards is int(total_progress×100) — total banked progress, not a timing average — so progress double-counts (chain ratio 0.6 weight + progress 0.4 weight) (alchemy.py:667; reward_calculator.py:329-338)
Exploded reactions are appended to locked_reactions, so an explosion still counts toward chains_completed (0.6-weight term) while also incurring the −0.15 penalty (alchemy.py:563, 664-667)

Three different vowel formulas coexist — reaction secret value: (ratio−0.2)×2.0 over isalpha() chars (alchemy.py:92-104); recipe volatility: (ratio−0.3)×2.5 over isalpha() chars (difficulty_calculator.py:466-479); max-quality shares: raw vowel membership count with no isalpha() gate (equivalent in practice for letter-only IDs, but underscores/digits are only excluded from the ratio denominators) (alchemy.py:388-397). Keep all three distinct.

itemId/materialId key-order duck typing is inconsistent: minigame + max-quality prefer 'itemId' then 'materialId' (alchemy.py:389, 534, 883, 922, 999); get_state display prefers 'materialId' first (alchemy.py:759); difficulty calculator prefers 'materialId' (difficulty_calculator.py:161). If both keys exist they can disagree; replicate the per-site order.

Success-path material consumption happens OUTSIDE this module (RecipeDatabase.consume_materials in game_engine), but craft_instant and the failure path deduct inline — asymmetric ownership must be preserved or materials get double/never consumed (alchemy.py:919-923, 996-1003, 1014-1015)
Failure loss uses int() floor per input: quantity 1 with loss_fraction < 1.0 loses nothing (alchemy.py:1000-1001)

Speed bonus (quicken buff + alchemyTime title) slows reaction timing but does NOT extend the brew countdown — despite the constructor arg being named buff_time_bonus (alchemy.py:332-357). Engine passes combined buff+title totals (game_engine.py:4260, 4280)
get_state 'current_ingredient_volatility' is actually relative importance: min(1.0, max_quality × ingredient_count), not the recipe/vowel volatility (alchemy.py:760-764)
Time-out auto-stabilize locks the CURRENT oscillating quality at that instant — it can bank a near-zero value at a sine trough (alchemy.py:548-551, 613-617)

Per-ingredient max qualities sum to exactly 1.0, so 100% progress requires locking every ingredient at its final oscillation peak; quality_fraction can only reach ~1.0 at that last peak because base caps at 0.45 and oscillation contributes ≤0.55 (alchemy.py:279-290, 399-410)

Difficulty tier lookup gap: DIFFICULTY_THRESHOLDS are integer bands (4,5)... — fractional points like 4.5 fall between 'common'(0-4) and 'uncommon'(5-10) and return the final 'common' fallback (difficulty_calculator.py:47-53, 764-772)
Rarity uniformity is a hard gate: mixed-rarity inputs refuse to craft at all; None rarity falls back to 'common' post-check (alchemy.py:886-893, 915-917, 1019-1021)

Both calculators are imported inside try/ImportError with distinct legacy fallback tables (stationTier-based difficulty; hardcoded quality bands) — in the shipped game the imports always succeed, but the fallback constants are part of the file's contract (alchemy.py:421-444, 481-499, 687-724)
Reaction visuals in stage 4 use random.uniform(−0.1, 0.1) jitter on size each update — cosmetic nondeterminism only (alchemy.py:218)
